Notes: THE FOUR ELEMENTS, AND WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. An Element is the thing a class shares with OTHER classes. A Lorelei is water; so is every water class you write later. That matters because of one rule: AN EMBLEM'S BASIC SIDE IS FED BY ELEMENT, AND ITS CONDITION IS FULFILLED BY CLASS. Any water unit, whatever its class, counts toward Gremory's Basic side; only a Lorelei can complete the Condition that turns it over. So a mixed water team gets a broader engine and gives up the Ultimate, and a mono-Lorelei team gets the Ultimate and a narrower engine. That is a real choice and it costs no code - the rule is the `Basic Feeds` column of an Emblems file, and `element` is its default.
